sections.title: Grand Rounds
sections.description: This course will be in the form of a monthly Penn conference for all the residents of graduate specialty programs in PDM. Each conference will include residents presentations of patients treatment with complex dental needs that require multi-disciplinary approach and then open discussion with all involved specialties as panel. This conference is designed to provide residents with an understanding of the sequential management of multidisciplinary cases from a diagnostic and treatment basis.
